name: role-replay
title: Role Replay
description: A spooky reality TV show where everyone has a secret trait. Can you stay in character and guess what others are hiding?
instructions: You'll get a secret trait. Answer the confessional prompt in character. Then, guess the secret traits of your fellow contestants!

amen.title: Fruits of the Spirit
